subject: history
concept: Understanding how historians evaluate primary versus secondary sources for reliability
source_inspiration: original content, building on P1 primary-source skills — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student sorts source examples into primary and secondary categories
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a source type to a factor that affects its reliability (bias, proximity to the event, purpose)
exercise.abstract: Student evaluates a given source's reliability for a specific historical question

misconception_flags: assumes a primary source is automatically more reliable than a secondary source regardless of context

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
